description: This file defines interfaces and extension methods related to stream lifecycle management in Orleans grains, including consumer and producer grain interfaces and helper extension methods for stream ID creation.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleConsumerGrainExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for stream lifecycle grains to simplify stream ID creation and method invocation.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Extension method to convert Guid to StreamId and call the grain's BecomeConsumer method.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Extension method to convert Guid to StreamId and call the grain's TestBecomeConsumerSlim method.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Extension method to convert Guid to StreamId and call the grain's RemoveConsumer method.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Extension method for IFilteredStreamConsumerGrain to convert Guid to StreamId and call the grain's BecomeConsumer method with sendEvensOnly parameter.

methods.name: SubscribeWithBadFunc
methods.description: Extension method to convert Guid to StreamId and call the grain's SubscribeWithBadFunc method.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Extension method to convert Guid to StreamId and call the grain's BecomeProducer method.
